title: Novaya Gazeta, Fiercely Independent Russian News Outlet, Says It Will Shut Down
summary: Journalists at Novaya Gazeta, whose co-founder received the Nobel Peace Prize, said the government had orchestrated its demise: “They killed us.”
body_markdown: Journalists at Novaya Gazeta, whose co-founder received the Nobel Peace Prize, said the government had orchestrated its demise: “They killed us.”
